types.emotion-as-substance: Find stock descriptions in which an abstract emotion or mental state behaves like a physical substance moving into, out of, through, or over a body, voice, room, or group. Read neighboring sentences for that specific cause; unrelated physical detail does not explain the emotion. Ordinary statements that someone feels an emotion belong to other types.
